name: trains-via-interrupt
title: Trains via Interrupt
author: Dirtyredz
description: Your station says no trains are coming, but six are parked at a holding station waiting for it. Vanilla's 'Trains with this stop' tab ignores interrupts, so interrupt-driven networks go blind. This adds a panel to the train stop window: which trains are wired up to this stop, and which want it right now. Handles wildcard interrupts, so parametrised drop-offs list the right trains instead of none or all of them.
